user.title: Add a NovaStar controller
user.description: Enter the IP address of the controller (for example a VX1000). Home Assistant connects to its control port and scans every output for receiving cards. The cards it finds become the expected layout, so any card that later stops answering is reported as a problem. Nothing is written to the controller unless you turn on control in the options.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50. The port is 5200 unless you changed it.

init.title: Options
init.description: How often to poll, when a card counts as too hot, and which entities to create.

data_description.card_entities: Turn off on very large screens to keep only the summary entities per output.
data_description.rescan: Use after you add, remove or re-cable cabinets. The cards found become the new expected layout.
data_description.allow_control: Creates entities that change the controller's settings. Off by default, so nothing can be written to the controller until you turn this on.
